// Passing fixture for untrusted-scan: every agent-written field reaches the page
// through UntrustedText's text prop, inline or as a block, on one line or several.
export function Ok({ r, q }) {
  const options = { reason: r.reason_untrusted }
  return (
    <div title="don't render raw text">
      <UntrustedText text={r.reason_untrusted} block />
      <UntrustedText
        source="whoever quarantined it"
        text={q.reason_untrusted}
      />
      <UntrustedText text={r.preview?.agent_reason_untrusted ?? ''} block maxHeight="max-h-40" />
      {r.reason_untrusted && <UntrustedText text={r.reason_untrusted} />}
    </div>
  )
}
